description: 10 synthetic behavior profiles for the SmartReco recommendation eval harness (PRD §10). Each profile is catalog-agnostic: it names target categories, preferred levels, and search terms, and the harness (evals/eval_recommendations.py) maps those onto real, active catalog rows at run time, seeds the corresponding behavioral events, rebuilds the decayed profile, and runs the real seven-node LangGraph agent. Profiles deliberately span two related categories each (with varied levels and distinct search vocabulary) so the recommendations differ across personas and so the diversity metric (>= 2 unique categories) is measurable without gaming.

schema.id: stable persona id; also the local-part of the synthetic user's email (eval-<id>@smartreco.eval)
schema.name: human-readable persona label
schema.summary: one-line description of the learner's intent (fed to the persuasion judge as context)
schema.target_categories: categories the learner engages with; the harness picks real products from these and expects recommendations to overlap them (behavioral relevance)
schema.preferred_levels: course levels the learner gravitates to; product selection prefers these levels first
schema.search_terms: search-event queries this learner issues (high-signal profile input)
schema.engage_per_category: how many products per target category to engage (view+click+dwell+cart); the harness caps this so at least one in-category product is always left un-engaged and therefore recommendable
